# Parity with Microsoft Office

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask parity` from parity/parity.json; do not edit by hand. -->

This page tracks the features people coming from Microsoft Office would miss, and the ones where Kiln aims to be better. Each row has a would-miss tier (critical, commonly-missed, niche), a delivery priority and a status; a row counts as done only when its named tests pass (`cargo xtask parity --verify`). The rules are in [parity/README.md](parity/README.md).

Tracker updated 2026-10-30. Overall score **89.6 %** over 740 rows in scope (19 out of scope).

Kiln Notes follows after the v0.1 release: its 45 rows stay in `parity/parity.json` and are not counted in the scores or listed on this page.

Legend: ★ better than Office · ● done · ◐ partial · ○ missing · – out of scope. Score = Σ tier weight × status weight ÷ Σ tier weight over rows in scope, with tier weights critical 3, commonly-missed 2, niche 0.5 and status weights missing 0, partial 0.5, done 1, better 1.

## Better than Office

Rows that exist to be better than Office (no Office equivalent, `office: "—"`) and rows already marked better.

| | Feature | App | Priority | Why it is better |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ★ | Focus mode: distraction-free page with the ribbon hidden | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word: the chrome fades instead of disappearing (hover brings it back), lines away from the caret dim and typewriter scrolling keeps the line centred; Esc or the status bar leaves. |
| ★ | Paste a Markdown table as a styled table | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word, which pastes Markdown as plain text: GitHub pipe tables (and the rest) paste as Word tables in the Table Grid style. |
| ○ | Stock images hook (configurable provider; no network by default) | Kiln Write | P1 | provider is user-configured and nothing is fetched unless enabled |
| ★ | One-click table of contents from headings | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word's gallery round trip: one click inserts a linked contents table from Heading 1–3 at the caret. |
| ★ | Callout blocks (note, tip, warning) that export as shaded paragraphs in .docx | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word, which has no callouts: Note, Tip, Warning and Important blocks that are shaded, bordered paragraphs, so Word shows them the same. |
| ★ | Code blocks with syntax highlighting and a monospace style | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word, which has no code blocks: a monospace style with keyword, string, comment and number highlighting; ``` and Enter starts one. |
| ★ | Version history pane: automatic snapshots on save, named versions, diff view, restore | Kiln Write | P0 | Versions on every save and every ten minutes of editing, named, shown read-only, compared word by word and restored as a new version, with no cloud account: shared documents with everyone in them, local files in the native file or on the device. |
| ★ | Markdown shortcuts while typing (#, -, 1., **bold**, `code`, ---, >) | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word's AutoFormat: #–######, -, 1., >, ---, ``` and **bold**, *italic*, `code`, ~~strike~~ as you type, undone in one step. |
| ★ | Smart paste: Markdown text becomes headings, lists, emphasis and code | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word, which pastes Markdown as text: headings, lists, emphasis, links, code and tables become Word formatting. |
| ★ | Word-count goal in the status bar with progress | Kiln Write | P0 | Better than Word, which has no goals: a goal saved with the document and an ember progress bar in the status bar. |
| ★ | Document outline health: skipped heading levels and empty headings flagged | Kiln Write | P1 | the Navigation pane lists headings that skip levels and empty headings, flags them in the heading tree and goes to them; Word only reports these in its Accessibility Checker. |
| ★ | Export to Markdown and HTML | Kiln Write | P0 | File ▸ Export and Save As write Markdown (CommonMark with tables, strikethrough and footnotes) and one-file semantic HTML with pictures embedded; .md files open as styled documents. Word has neither Markdown export nor Markdown opening. |
| ★ | Command palette in the ribbon (Ctrl+Shift+P / Alt+Q) with Office synonyms | Kiln Grid | P0 | Ctrl+Shift+P (or Alt+Q / the search box) does a fuzzy search over every Grid command with Excel's names and everyday synonyms ("number series" finds Series…), shows each shortcut (AutoSum Alt+=), runs the command and hands the keys back to the sheet. |
| ★ | Recommended Charts from the selection's shape | Kiln Grid | P0 | suggestions computed locally from the data shape, previewed live Engine done (kiln-charts: model, layout, rendering, OOXML read/write, SuiteCommand::Chart* editing; ui-kit chart chrome). Hosted on Grid sheets: inserted from the selection, drawn in the sheet's tiles, selected, moved, resized, edited with Chart Design, Format and the Format pane, undone, and saved to .xlsx. |
| ★ | Formula Lab: formula explainer pane with AST tree and step values | Kiln Grid | P0 | Formula Lab follows the active cell: the formula as a tree with every part’s value, the functions’ documentation, branches not evaluated, and the reduction step by step. |
| ★ | From JSON (array of objects to a table) | Kiln Grid | P0 | Data ▸ From JSON reads an array of records (or arrays) into a table with a preview, onto a new sheet or at the active cell, without Power Query. |
| ○ | Version history with cell-level diff | Kiln Grid | P1 | cell-level diff of local files with no cloud account |
| ★ | Export a range or table as JSON | Kiln Grid | P0 | Data ▸ Export writes the selection or the sheet as JSON records keyed by the header row, numbers as numbers. |
| ★ | Convert a bulleted list to a list diagram (grouped, editable shapes) | Kiln Deck | P1 | unlike Convert to SmartArt, Convert to List Diagram (Basic Block List, Basic Process, Vertical Bullet List) makes plain grouped shapes that stay editable in every app. |
| ★ | Design Ideas pane: layout and theme-variant suggestions for the current slide's content | Kiln Deck | P0 | suggestions computed locally, no cloud service or account. Four to six layouts and a dark variant from the slide's title, text, pictures, tables and charts, drawn as pictures; applying one is one undo step and replaces the last. |
| ★ | Code block with syntax highlighting | Kiln Deck | P0 | Insert ▸ Code Block puts code in a shaded Consolas text box with Write's syntax colours as run colours, so it opens highlighted in PowerPoint and survives the .pptx round trip as formatted text. |
| ○ | Live Grid range linked from a workbook | Kiln Deck | P1 | a linked table that refreshes without OLE |
| ★ | Present in a browser tab | Kiln Deck | P0 | Present in Browser Tab plays the show in the tab, without full screen, keys and pointer tools included; PowerPoint has no such mode. |
| ★ | Version history with slide thumbnails per version | Kiln Deck | P0 | Review ▸ Version History shows each version's slides as thumbnails with the new and changed ones marked, a version read-only and restored as a new version: shared presentations and local files. |
| ★ | Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P / Alt+Q) with fuzzy search, recent commands and Office synonyms | Suite | P0 | Fuzzy search over every command with Office names and everyday synonyms, shortcuts and recent commands; Office's Tell me has no synonyms or shortcuts. 448 commands carry Office names and everyday phrasings, with Office's German and Arabic names. |
| ★ | Shortcut cheat sheet (Ctrl+/) and remappable keyboard page | Suite | P0 | every binding listed, searchable and remappable in Options ▸ Keyboard, with conflicts named before and after a change, export and import as JSON, and the sheet (Ctrl+/) showing the keys as remapped. |
| ◐ | Byte-preserving saves: every part not edited is byte-identical after save | Suite | P0 | saving never rewrites what you did not touch (GenOffice's bar). Partial: the package layer repacks every feature fixture byte-identically part by part; saves from the apps arrive with the writers; .pptx: untouched parts byte-identical on every corpus deck, and session saves with TouchedParts copy untouched slides, layouts, masters and notes pages |
| ★ | Native bundles (.kwrite/.kgrid/.kdeck), with version history in .kwrite and .kdeck | Suite | P0 | .kwrite and .kdeck carry their own version history; all three carry the original Office file and which of its parts the edits touched, so saving as Office again writes what an ordinary save would (the touched parts from the model, every other part, macros and custom XML included, byte for byte); an original that cannot be read is a loss the Compatibility Checker lists. |
| ★ | Version history: snapshots on save, named versions, restore | Suite | P0 | Versions of shared documents travel with the document on your own relay and everyone sees one list; local files keep theirs in the native file or on the device. Kiln Write and Kiln Deck. |
| ◐ | Linux desktop (AppImage, deb) | Suite | P0 | Microsoft 365 has no Linux desktop app. AppImage and .deb from pnpm tauri build (profile dist), checked by tools/verify-bundles.sh; the AppImage carries WebKitGTK and is over its B13 budget. |
| ○ | `kiln` CLI: convert, render, inspect, eval, batch | Suite | P0 | headless conversion and inspection without Office installed |
| ○ | JSON control channel over stdio for every command | Suite | P0 | every command scriptable without VBA |
| ○ | MCP server and agent skill over the control channel | Suite | P1 | agents drive Kiln locally |
| ○ | No telemetry, no account, nothing fetched from third parties | Suite | P0 | no account or telemetry at all |

Out of scope:

| Function | Family | Why |
|---|---|---|
| CALL | add-in | Calls a DLL; native code execution is never offered |
| COPILOT | text | Needs Microsoft's online AI service; Kiln's own AI hooks are off by default |
| CUBEKPIMEMBER | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| CUBEMEMBER | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| CUBEMEMBERPROPERTY | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| CUBERANKEDMEMBER | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| CUBESET | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| CUBESETCOUNT | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| CUBEVALUE | cube | OLAP cube connections are out of scope |
| DETECTLANGUAGE | text | Needs Microsoft's online translation service |
| FIELDVALUE | lookup | Needs linked data types from Microsoft's online services |
| FILTERXML | web | Web family, used with WEBSERVICE; out of scope |
| IMAGE | lookup | Fetches pictures from URLs; network access from formulas is out of scope |
| REGISTER.ID | add-in | Registers a DLL; native code execution is never offered |
| RTD | lookup | Real-time data needs a COM automation server |
| STOCKHISTORY | information | Needs Microsoft's online financial data service |
| TRANSLATE | text | Needs Microsoft's online translation service |
| WEBSERVICE | web | Network access from formulas is out of scope |
